settings.heading: Size Guide
settings.body:
Ring Sizing

UK ring sizes range from A to Z+. If you're unsure of your size, we recommend visiting one of our showrooms for a fitting, or using a printable ring sizer.

Bracelet Sizing

Measure your wrist snugly with a soft tape measure and add 1–1.5cm for comfort.

Necklace Lengths

Our necklaces typically range from 40cm (choker) to 60cm (matinee length).

Placeholder sizing information for development purposes — to be confirmed with final product specifications.
